Payoff beats: L0033 (conclusion), L0073 (punchline), L0116 (punchline), L0164 (punchline), L0198 (punchline), L0329 (punchline), L0382 (emotional_peak), L0418 (conclusion), L0439 (punchline), L0457 (reveal).

Scene Breakdown:
- L0001-L0044: Abhi on phone with his Dad. Dad wants him to meet Harshitba for marriage. Setup.
- L0045-L0085: Harshitha confronts Abhi outside Meera's flat; Abhi explains his one-sided love logic. Conflict.
- L0086-L0117: Meera appears calling him 'Vijay'. Harshitha realizes his fake identity and forces her way into the flat. Conflict / Escalation.
- L0118-L0165: Inside flat: Harshitha quizzes him in front of Meera; Abhi frantically covers up name and college details. Comedic tension.
- L0166-L0214: Prank travel agent call trying to bribe Harshitha with a free Bangkok trip. Comedy.
- L0215-L0279: Harshitha stays in the flat; Dad calls and Harshitha answers. Conflict.
- L0280-L0333: Cafe scene: Harshitha talks to Sindhu; Sindhu interrogates her background; Harshitha gives rich-to-poor punchline. Comedy.
- L0334-L0365: Kitchen scene: Abhi cuts onions, Meera gets teary, Abhi tends to her eyes. Romance.
- L0366-L0386: Harshitha asks Meera if she also loves Vijay. Romantic / emotional probe.
- L0387-L0424: Abhi drops Harshitha off; she gracefully departs with advice on love. Resolution.
- L0425-L0451: Abhi and friend have beer; friend reminds him his wealth is the real barrier. Reality check.
- L0452-L0458: Dad enters the cafe asking for Abhi. Cliffhanger ending.

proposals.text: నువ్వు విజయ్ friend ఆ? అవును. అంటే school friend ఆ? college friend ఆ? లేదా colony friend ఆ? మూడు. ఓహ్ అంటే close friends ఏ అయి ఉంటారుగా. హ్మ్. హ్మ్ నువ్వు ఏ school? ఏంటి? I mean ఏ school లో friends అని అడుగుతున్నా. Delhi public school. ఓహ్ college? St. Mary's. అయితే మీరు చాలా rich అనుకుంటానుగా. అవును. ఉమ్ దొరికేసింది. దీనికి doubt వచ్చినట్టుంది. హ్మ్ విజయ్ కూడా rich అనుకుంటానుగా. Actually మా parents మమ్మల్ని చదివించుకు ముందు చాలా rich ఉండేవాళ్ళం. మమ్మల్ని చదివించాకే poor అయిపోయాం.
proposals.title: చదువుకున్నాకే poor అయిపోయాం
proposals.why_it_works: A slow questioning cross-examination pays off with a genuinely funny relatable punchline about school fees.

end_hold.note: next line starts quickly: ends on the shot change

discovery.what_happens: Sindhu grills Harshitha at the cafe about her school and background with Vijay. When Sindhu suspects that they come from wealthy families, Harshitha delivers a witty retort.
discovery.hook: Sindhu interrogates Harshitha: 'Are you Vijay's school, college, or colony friend?' and Harshitha replies: 'All three.'
discovery.payoff: Harshitha deadpans that their parents were very rich before paying for their education, and became poor only afterwards.
